prompt:
Create a NEW epic full-body game character selection sprite of Illapa for the TerraSonic band's roster, using the supplied current model as the strict identity and rendering reference. The imposing storm drummer braces in a wide powerful three-quarter lunge, one boot forward, one hand steadying the large strapped wankara and one raising the drum beater high in an unmistakable ready-to-strike diagonal. The patterned cape sweeps behind. Keep the hat, lightning goggles and sling. Composed stern gaze and closed mouth.

Make the action unmistakably different from the reference's standing pose. Show the entire figure, all limbs, footwear, headwear and every instrument tip with at least 6% clear margin on every side, portrait aspect ratio around 2:3. Place the figure centrally and near the bottom, at a consistent scale suited to a five-character roster. One character only. The pose carries the drama. No extra action effects.

Match the reference's detailed cartoon drawing and fine tiny STAR POINTS tracing contours. Use exclusively its magenta hue, with restrained brightness, minimal pinpoint glow, and clear facial features drawn as thin stars. The body, face, clothing and instrument are hollow cutouts. All gaps, including enclosed holes inside skin, cloth and instruments, must be real transparent alpha. The dark reference background is only a preview surface. No filled shapes or skin planes, no black backing shape, no bloom, no haze, no background, no scenery, no lettering, no border and no UI elements. Preserve culturally inspired motifs, anatomy and character identity. Output one isolated transparent sprite.
